name: ide-luals
author: lumine-code
description: Provide Lua language intelligence through LuaLS.

serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Absolute path to lua-language-server. Leave empty to use the managed installation, then PATH.

notifyWhenMissing.title: Notify When Missing
notifyWhenMissing.description: Offer to install LuaLS when its executable is missing.

runtimeVersion.title: Lua Version
runtimeVersion.description: Select a fallback Lua runtime for analysis. Project .luarc.json settings take precedence.

libraryPaths.title: Library Paths
libraryPaths.description: Additional absolute directories containing Lua source or annotated libraries. Project .luarc.json can supply relative paths.

globals.title: Globals
globals.description: Additional names provided by an embedded Lua runtime, such as application APIs.

features.title: Features
features.description: Choose which LuaLS results the editor uses.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Report Lua syntax and type problems.

autocomplete.title: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: Complete Lua symbols, modules and annotations.

hover.title: Hover
hover.description: Show Lua types and symbol documentation.

signature.title: Signature Help
signature.description: Show function parameters while entering arguments.

definition.title: Go To Definition
definition.description: Navigate to definitions, implementations and annotated types.

references.title: Find References
references.description: Find symbol uses across Lua modules.

format.title: Format
format.description: Format Lua documents, selections and typed text.

rename.title: Rename
rename.description: Rename Lua symbols across the project.

codeActions.title: Code Actions
codeActions.description: Apply LuaLS fixes and source changes.

inlayHints.title: Inlay Hints
inlayHints.description: Show inferred types and parameter names inline.

semanticTokens.title: Semantic Tokens
semanticTokens.description: Highlight Lua symbols using their resolved meaning.
